notes: The no of pour no oil is on לֹא, the clause's negation recast as a determiner on the object (rule 15).
The fronted the of the tenth part of an ephah belongs to the rectum's article under rule 29, the rectum itself being rendered anarthrously with the indefinite an on the noun.
The supplied of before barley meal is given to קֶמַח, the noun heading the appositional measure phrase (rule 33), the unit discontinuous around barley.
